name: Thunder Claps!
source:
One day main heroine wakes up with supernatural abilities. An evil sidekick attacks a peaceful supermarket, and heroine decides to fight evil on regular basis starting with this day. She is inexperienced and prone to mistakes while facing stronger enemies, but please support her to your best!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
